description: Source code for extending and customizing stock picking functionality in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including weight calculation and invoice creation logic.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extended stock.picking class with custom weight calculation and invoice creation methods.

methods.name: _cal_weight
methods.description: Calculates total weight of stock pickings based on move lines and product weights.

methods.name: _get_picking_line
methods.description: Retrieves picking IDs from stock move lines.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoices from stock pickings, assigns delivery carrier info, and adds invoice lines for carriers.
